item.title: Young sons of U.S. marshal ride horseback from Oklahoma to New York (2018)
item.description:
📝 The boys’ father agreed to their cross-country ride and helped them plan the route. Abernathy postulated a few rules before they set out: They could not travel more than 50 miles in one day; they could not cross water without an adult present unless they could see the bottom; they could not carry more than $5 with them at one time; and they could not travel on Sundays. As they rode east, newspaper reporters gathered to meet them.
🔗 Read more: https://texascooppower.com/the-astonishing-ride-of-the-abernathy-boys/
